in_chain_replicate.registered_in: docs/readiness/2026-09-27-slurp-stage3-wave1-aa-fold-a-v1 (the coordinator's shared A/A package; attempt id added 2026-09-27 so scripts/flights/read_paired_cell.sh can open the A/A's sealed manifest -- stage3_paired_read.py reads arms.in_chain_replicate.attempt_id)
in_chain_replicate.role: the within-chain null the delta is read at (the AGREE arm's own bytes; registered by the coordinator)

boundary: A development read on a TRAIN construction fold (owner decisions 28 and 86); never a test claim. No utterance text, transcript, gold filler or model output is printed or persisted.
decision_rule: NO-HARM ADMITTED (owner decision 127): against the SHARED in-chain A/A SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WAVE1-AA-FOLD-A-V1 (the retained AGREE arm's own bytes, registered by the coordinator for wave items W1-W4) flown in the same chain, the paired CI95 lower bound of the intent-accuracy delta (primary, decision 133) is not below -0.9943 pp AND the paired CI95 lower bound of the official pooled SLU-F1 delta (the guard) is not below -1.2485 pp -- each at its own Fold A own-null half-width (PLAN vs PLANr, docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d; the G5 precedent). HARMFUL: a measured loss on either metric (CI95 upper bound below zero, decision 25). NEUTRAL-BY-WIDTH IS THE ADMISSION (decision 127). Never reported as a gain; two base items are never assumed to add (decision 138). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the measured Solver prompt-token delta per contact and per row from the sealed COST records, and the registered harm rows (5 rows that lose a gold-type card) read row by row.
steps: 1. Refuse unless BOTH the W1 arm and the shared in-chain A/A carry a COMPLETE sealed manifest at 1,080 rows with the committed roster's ids, each with one successful complete official TRAIN score.

2. Structural stage: on the arm, every Solver card selection is a subset of the one the A/A made on the same Perception shortlist; the per-row card count and the Solver prompt tokens per contact from the sealed COST records against the A/A (expected about -1,186 per Solver contact where the shortlist agrees).
3. Score once per arm over the complete manifest with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch, never sharded.

4. Paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260927) of the arm minus A/A delta on intent accuracy and official pooled SLU-F1, point and CI95; the delta against the sealed AGREE arm reported BESIDE it, never instead of it.
5. ADMITTED iff intent lower bound >= -0.9943 and SLU lower bound >= -1.2485; HARMFUL iff either upper bound < 0; otherwise NOT ADMITTED (width). Never write 'gain' or 'no gain'.

6. Report: per-scenario tables in both weightings; the frontier row (decision 75); the registered harm rows of card-selection-measurement-v1.json read row by row (ids and type names only); the rows whose delivered answer used a dropped type.
title: Cell W1 -- the standard paired roster read on intent + SLU at the shared in-chain A/A, under the no-harm rule
